messages:
mike: Planning Tue 02:00 UTC two-wave deploy: api+runtime then router+console. Need owners and rollback windows.

sara: I can own wave1 (api+runtime). Suggest 15m quiet window.

tim: Router oncall, I'll take wave2 + console. Extend to 20m if latencies creep.

mike: Rollback triggers: errors >2% for 5m OR p50 >500ms. Add other checks?

jen: Add KV cache-miss spike >3x baseline as rollback. I will prep console rollback steps.

deploy-bot: Scheduled wave1 2027-07-22T02:00:00Z, wave2 2027-07-22T02:30:00Z. Pins: api:v3.2.1, runtime:runtime-canary-07.

sara: Health check I'll run: `curl -sS https://api.stable/health | jq .status` expect "ok". Will post metrics at 10m and 20m.

ops-bot: To pause wave2 either `@deploy-bot hold wave2` or `deployctl hold --wave 2`. Deploybot will post status.

mike: I'll create temporary alerts for p50 and kv-miss. Wave1 owners: sara+mike. Wave2 owners: tim+jen. Kick if no objections.

sara: Canary 10m: errors 0.4% (0.3 baseline), p50 210ms, kv-miss 1.1x. All green.

tim: Router seeing +1 header parse errors, watching. Will call hold if trend continues.

deploy-bot: wave1 complete, steady. Wave2 scheduled at 2027-07-22T02:30:00Z.
